local _ = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
local _ = Enum.Font.Gotham
local _ = Enum.Font.SourceSans
local _ = Enum.Font.Legacy
local _ = Enum.Font.Arial
local _ = Enum.Font.Code
local _ = Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold
local _ = Enum.Font.Fantasy
local _ = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
local _ = Enum.Font.TitilliumWeb
function t1.value32(p15)
    if p15 == t1.value27 then
        return
    end

    local Head = (p15.Character or p15.CharacterAdded:Wait()):WaitForChild("Head")

    if Head:FindFirstChild("NameTag") then
        return
    end

    local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

    BillboardGui.Name = "NameTag"
    BillboardGui.Adornee = Head
    BillboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 20)
    BillboardGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
    BillboardGui.Parent = Head

    local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    TextLabel.TextColor3 = t1.value29
    TextLabel.TextScaled = true
    TextLabel.Font = t1.value30
    TextLabel.Text = ""
    TextLabel.Parent = BillboardGui
    t1.value28[p15] = TextLabel
end
function t1.value33(p16)
    local Character = p16.Character

    if Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
        local NameTag = Character.Head:FindFirstChild("NameTag")

        if NameTag then
            NameTag:Destroy()
        end
    end

    t1.value28[p16] = nil
end
RunService3.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not t1.value25 then
        return
    end

    for k, v in pairs(t1.value28) do
        local v208 = k
        local Character = v208.Character

        if Character then
            Character = v208.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and (t1.value27.Character and t1.value27.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        end

        if Character then
            local Magnitude = (v208.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - t1.value27.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude

            v.Text = string.format("%s [%d]", v208.DisplayName, (math.floor(Magnitude)))
            v.TextColor3 = t1.value29
            v.Font = t1.value30
        end
    end
end)

Tab6:AddToggle({
	Name = "مضاد جلوس",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(p20)
    if p20 then
        t1.value34 = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local Humanoid = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

            if Humanoid then
                Humanoid.Sit = false
                Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
            end
        end)

        return
    end

    if t1.value34 then
        t1.value34:Disconnect()

        local Humanoid = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        if Humanoid then
            Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
        end
    end
end
})

Tab6:AddToggle({
	Name = "مضاد SkyBox",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(p25)
    _G.AntiSky = p25

    if p25 then
        local v247 = settings()

        v247.Physics.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle = Enum.EnviromentalPhysicsThrottle.Disabled
        v247.Rendering.QualityLevel = 1
        setfpscap(999)
        task.spawn(function()
            while _G.AntiSky do
                setfpscap(999)

                for _, child in ipairs(game:GetService("Lighting"):GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Sky") or (child:IsA("Atmosphere") or child:IsA("Clouds")) then
                        child:Destroy()
                    end
                end

                game:GetService("Lighting").ExposureCompensation = 0
                game:GetService("Lighting").Brightness = 2
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end)
    end

Tab6:AddToggle({
	Name = "مضاد زعطوط",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(p26)
    if p26 then
        local HumanoidRootPartCFrame
        t1.value39 = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local Character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character

            if not Character then
                return
            end

            local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if not HumanoidRootPart then
                return
            end

            for _, player5 in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                if not (player5 ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer and workspace:FindFirstChild(player5.Name)) then
                    continue
                end

                local FollowCharacter = workspace[player5.Name]:FindFirstChild("FollowCharacter")

                if FollowCharacter and FollowCharacter:FindFirstChild("Torso") and (FollowCharacter.Torso.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude < 6 then
                    HumanoidRootPartCFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
                    HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -200, 0)
                    task.wait(2)

                    if HumanoidRootPart and HumanoidRootPartCFrame then
                        game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(HumanoidRootPart, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
								CFrame = HumanoidRootPartCFrame
							}):Play()
                    end

                    task.wait(2.5)

                    return
                end
            end
        end)

        return
    end

    if t1.value39 then
        t1.value39:Disconnect()
    end
end
})
Tab6:AddToggle({
	Name = "مضاد نسخ سكنات",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(p27)
    t1.value40 = p27

    if p27 then
        local Players2 = game:GetService("Players")
        local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
        local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local LocalPlayer3 = Players2.LocalPlayer
        local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
        local WaitForChild = Remotes.WaitForChild
        local GetPlayers = Players2.GetPlayers
        local v258 = WaitForChild(Remotes, "ResetCharacterAppearance")

        local function v259(p28)
            local t13 = {}
            local GetAccessories = p28.GetAccessories

            for _, v in ipairs(GetAccessories(p28, true)) do
                if v.AssetId then
                    t13[v.AssetId] = true
                end
            end

            return t13
        end
        local function v260(p29)
            if not p29.Character or not LocalPlayer3.Character then
                return
            end

            local HumanoidRootPart = LocalPlayer3.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local HumanoidRootPart2 = p29.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if not HumanoidRootPart or not HumanoidRootPart2 then
                return
            end

            TweenService:Create(HumanoidRootPart, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
					CFrame = HumanoidRootPart2.CFrame
				}):Play()
        end
        local function v261(p30)
            if p30 == LocalPlayer3 then
                return
            end

            task.spawn(function()
                while t1.value40 and p30.Parent do
                    if p30.Character and LocalPlayer3.Character then
                        local Humanoid = LocalPlayer3.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local Humanoid2 = p30.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                        if Humanoid and Humanoid2 then
                            local GetAppliedDescription = Humanoid.GetAppliedDescription
                            local v1802 = v259(GetAppliedDescription(Humanoid))
                            local v1803 = v259(Humanoid2:GetAppliedDescription())
                            local n5 = 0

                            for k in pairs(v1802) do
                                if v1803[k] then
                                    n5 += 1
                                end
                            end

                            if n5 >= 3 then
                                v258:FireServer()
                                task.wait(0.1)
                                v260(p30)
                                task.wait(1)
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.2)
                end
            end)
        end

        for _, v in ipairs(GetPlayers(Players2)) do
            v261(v)
        end

        Players2.PlayerAdded:Connect(v261)
    end
end
})
Tab6:AddToggle({
	Name = "مضاد ابواب",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(p31)
    if not _G.hiddenDoors then
        _G.hiddenDoors = {}
    end

    if p31 then
        _G.hiddenDoors = {}

        for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Name:lower():find("door") then
                local descendantTransparency = descendant.Transparency
                local CanCollide = descendant.CanCollide
                local CastShadow = descendant.CastShadow
                local t14 = {
						door = descendant,
						originalTransparency = descendantTransparency,
						originalCanCollide = CanCollide,
						originalCastShadow = CastShadow
					}

                descendant.Transparency = 1
                descendant.CanCollide = false
                descendant.CastShadow = false

                local GetChildren = descendant.GetChildren

                for _, v in ipairs(GetChildren(descendant)) do
                    if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                        v.Transparency = 1
                        v.CanCollide = false
                    elseif v:IsA("SurfaceGui") or v:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                        v.Enabled = false
                    end
                end

                table.insert(_G.hiddenDoors, t14)
            end
        end

        return
    end

    for _, v in ipairs(_G.hiddenDoors or {}) do
        if v.door and v.door.Parent then
            v.door.Transparency = v.originalTransparency
            v.door.CanCollide = v.originalCanCollide
            v.door.CastShadow = v.originalCastShadow

            for _, child in ipairs(v.door:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                    child.Transparency = 0
                    child.CanCollide = true
                elseif child:IsA("SurfaceGui") or child:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                    child.Enabled = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    _G.hiddenDoors = {}
end
})
Tab6:AddToggle({
	Name = "مضاد فلينج قوي",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(p32)
    t1.value42 = p32

    if p32 then
        local t15 = {
				Vehicles = {},
				Canoes = {},
				Jets = {},
				Helis = {},
				Balls = {}
			}

        local function v280(p33, p34)
            task.spawn(function()
                while t1.value42 do
                    local v1806 = p34()

                    if v1806 then
                        local GetChildren = v1806.GetChildren

                        for _, v in ipairs(GetChildren(v1806)) do
                            local v1810 = false

                            if p33 == "Vehicles" then
                                for _, descendant in ipairs(v:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if descendant:IsA("VehicleSeat") or descendant:IsA("Seat") and (descendant.Occupant and descendant.Occupant.Parent == game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character) then
                                        v1810 = true

                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            elseif p33 == "Canoes" then
                                v1810 = v:FindFirstChild("Owner")

                                if v1810 then
                                    v1810 = v1810.Value == game.Players.LocalPlayer
                                end
                            else
                                local v1813 = p33 == "Jets"

                                if not v1813 then
                                    v1813 = p33 == "Helis"
                                end

                                if v1813 then
                                    v1810 = v.Name == game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name
                                end
                            end

                            if not v1810 then
                                table.insert(t15[p33], v:Clone())
                                v:Destroy()
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.03)
                end
            end)
        end

        v280("Vehicles", function()
            return workspace:FindFirstChild("Vehicles")
        end)
        v280("Canoes", function()
            local WorkspaceCom = workspace:FindFirstChild("WorkspaceCom")

            return WorkspaceCom and WorkspaceCom:FindFirstChild("001_CanoeStorage")
        end)
        v280("Jets", function()
            local WorkspaceCom = workspace:FindFirstChild("WorkspaceCom")

            if WorkspaceCom and WorkspaceCom:FindFirstChild("001_Airport") then
                local AirportHanger = WorkspaceCom["001_Airport"]:FindFirstChild("AirportHanger")

                return AirportHanger and (AirportHanger:FindFirstChild("001_JetStorage") and AirportHanger["001_JetStorage"]:FindFirstChild("JetAirport"))
            end
        end)
        v280("Helis", function()
            local WorkspaceCom = workspace:FindFirstChild("WorkspaceCom")

            return WorkspaceCom and (WorkspaceCom:FindFirstChild("001_HeliStorage") and WorkspaceCom["001_HeliStorage"]:FindFirstChild("PoliceStationHeli"))
        end)
        v280("Balls", function()
            local WorkspaceCom = workspace:FindFirstChild("WorkspaceCom")

            return WorkspaceCom and WorkspaceCom:FindFirstChild("001_SoccerBalls")
        end)
    end
end
})
Tab6:AddToggle({
	Name = "مضاد لاق قوي",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(p35)
    t1.value43 = p35
    if not p35 then
        return
    end
    local Players3 = game:GetService("Players")
    local t16 = {}
    local u284
    local function v285(p36)
        local t17 = {}
        local t18 = {}

        if p36.Character then
            table.insert(t18, p36.Character)
        end

        local Backpack = p36:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

        if Backpack then
            table.insert(t18, Backpack)
        end

        local StarterGear = p36:FindFirstChild("StarterGear")

        if StarterGear then
            table.insert(t18, StarterGear)
        end

        for _, v in ipairs(t18) do
            local GetChildren = v.GetChildren

            for _, v3 in ipairs(GetChildren(v)) do
                if v3:IsA("Tool") then
                    table.insert(t17, v3)
                end
            end
        end

        return t17
    end
    local function v286(p37)
        if p37 == u284 then
            return
        end

        if t16[p37] then
            return
        end

        t16[p37] = true

        local v1295 = v285(p37)

        if #v1295 > 1 then
            for i = 2, #v1295 do
                pcall(function()
                    v1295[i]:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end

        t16[p37] = false
    end
    local function v287(p38)
        if not u284 then
            u284 = p38
        end

        task.defer(v286, p38)

        local function v1298(p39)
            task.delay(0.5, function()
                v286(p38)
            end)
            p39.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    task.delay(0.1, function()
                        v286(p38)
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        if p38.Character then
            v1298(p38.Character)
        end

        p38.CharacterAdded:Connect(v1298)

        local Backpack = p38:WaitForChild("Backpack", 10)

        if Backpack then
            Backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    task.delay(0.1, function()
                        v286(p38)
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        local v1300 = p38:FindFirstChild("StarterGear") or p38:WaitForChild("StarterGear", 10)

        if v1300 then
            v1300.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    task.delay(0.1, function()
                        v286(p38)
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    Players3.PlayerAdded:Connect(v287)
    for _, player6 in ipairs(Players3:GetPlayers()) do
        v287(player6)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while t1.value43 do
            for _, player7 in ipairs(Players3:GetPlayers()) do
                v286(player7)
            end

            task.wait(2)
        end
    end)
end
})
Tab6:AddToggle({
	Name = "مضاد بارت قوي",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(p40)
    t1.value44 = p40

    if p40 then
        t1.value41 = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if descendant.Velocity.Magnitude > 100 then
                        descendant.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                        descendant.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    end

                    if (descendant.Position.Y > 1000 or descendant.Position.Y < -1000) and descendant.CanCollide then
                        descendant.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        return
    end

    if t1.value41 then
        t1.value41:Disconnect()
    end
end
})

function playTeleportEffect()
    blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
    blur.Size = 0
    blur.Parent = game.Lighting

    for i = 1, 10 do
        blur.Size = i * 2
        task.wait(0.01)
    end

    task.wait(0.1)

    for i = 10, 1, -1 do
        blur.Size = i * 2
        task.wait(0.01)
    end

    blur:Destroy()
end
for _, v in pairs(TeleportLocations) do
    local v79 = v
    local _TeleportTab = TeleportTab
    local Name = v79.Name
    local AddButton = _TeleportTab.AddButton
    local v83 = "اذهب إلى " .. v79.Name

    AddButton(_TeleportTab, {
		Name = Name,
		Description = v83,
		Callback = function()
        player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

        if not player.Character or not player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

            if player.Character then
                player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            end

            repeat
                task.wait()
            until player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        end

        playTeleportEffect()
        player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = v79.CFrame
    end
	})
end
BangTab = v6:MakeTab({
	"بانق",
	"rbxassetid://"
})
Players = game:GetService("Players")
RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
getgenv().selectedPlayer = nil
Dropdown = nil
function rebuildDropdown()
    if Dropdown then
        Dropdown:Destroy()
    end

    playerNames = {}

    for _, player8 in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player8 ~= LocalPlayer then
            table.insert(playerNames, player8.Name)
        end
    end

    local _BangTab = BangTab
    local _playerNames = playerNames

    Dropdown = _BangTab:AddDropdown({
		Name = "حدد لاعب",
		Options = _playerNames,
		Default = "",
		Callback = function(p41)
        getgenv().selectedPlayer = p41
    end
	})
end
rebuildDropdown()
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(rebuildDropdown)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(rebuildDropdown)

function createBangToggle(p42, p43, p44)
    bangActive = false
    connection = nil
    togglePosition = false
    BangTab:AddToggle({
		Name = p42,
		Default = false,
		Callback = function(p45)
        bangActive = p45
        char = LocalPlayer.Character

        if not char then
            return
        end

        humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if not humanoid then
            return
        end

        if p45 then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = true

            if connection then
                connection:Disconnect()
            end

            connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if bangActive and getgenv().selectedPlayer then
                    targetPlayer = Players:FindFirstChild(getgenv().selectedPlayer)

                    if targetPlayer and (targetPlayer.Character and targetPlayer.Character.PrimaryPart) then
                        targetHead = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

                        if targetHead and char.PrimaryPart then
                            offset = not togglePosition and 4 or 1

                            if p44 then
                                char:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(targetHead.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1, -offset) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
                            else
                                char:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(targetHead.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, p43, offset))
                            end

                            togglePosition = not togglePosition
                            task.wait(1)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)

            return
        end

        humanoid.PlatformStand = false

        if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
    end
	})
end
createBangToggle("Bang v1 | خلفي v1", -1, false)
createBangToggle("Bang v2 | خلفي v2", -1.5, false)
createBangToggle("Face Bang v1 | أمامي v1", 1, true)
createBangToggle("Face Bang v2 | أمامي v2", 1.5, true)

function t1.value51()
    if t1.value48 then
        local t48 = {
			t1.value47,
			t1.value48,
			1
		}

        t1.value45.RE:FindFirstChild("1Gu1nSound1s"):FireServer(unpack(t48))

        local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")

        Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. t1.value48
        Sound.Parent = t1.value46.LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        Sound:Play()
    end
end
function t1.value52()
    while t1.value49 do
        t1.value51()
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end
v85:AddButton({
	Name = "تشغيل الصوت",
	Callback = function()
    t1.value51()
end
})

    if t1.value49 then
        task.spawn(t1.value52)
    end
end
})
function t1.value53(p49)
    local v333 = workspace:FindFirstChild("Audio all client")

    if not v333 then
        v333 = Instance.new("Folder")
        v333.Name = "Audio all client"
        v333.Parent = workspace
    end

    local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")

    Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. p49
    Sound.Volume = 1
    Sound.Looped = false
    Sound.Parent = v333
    Sound:Play()
    task.delay(1, function()
        Sound:Destroy()
    end)
end
function t1.value54(p50)
    if type(p50) ~= "number" then
        return
    end

    local v336 = t1.value45:FindFirstChild("1Gu1nSound1s", true)

    if v336 then
        v336:FireServer(t1.value47, p50, 1)
    end
end

    end

v90:AddButton({
	"شادر 1",
	function()
    local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local RunService4 = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
    local LocalPlayer4 = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local Model = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Model")
    local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")

    Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://131644923"
    Sound.Volume = 1
    Sound.Parent = SoundService
    Sound:Play()

    if Model then
        local function u348(p53)
            local GetChildren = p53.GetChildren

            for _, v in pairs(GetChildren(p53)) do
                if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                    v.Material = Enum.Material.Basalt
                elseif v:IsA("Model") or v:IsA("Folder") then
                    u348(v)
                end
            end
        end

        if Model:FindFirstChild("001_SnowStreet") then
            u348(Model["001_SnowStreet"])
        end

        if Model:FindFirstChild("Street") then
            for _, descendant in pairs(Model.Street:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                    descendant.Material = Enum.Material.Basalt
                end
            end
        end

        for _, child in pairs(Model:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name == "Sidewalk" or child.Name == "Wedge" and child.Material == Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic then
                child.Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone
            end
        end

        Model.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name == "Sidewalk" or child.Name == "Wedge" and child.Material == Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic then
                child.Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone
            end
        end)
    end

    local Part = Instance.new("Part")

    Part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Part.Transparency = 1
    Part.Anchored = true
    Part.CanCollide = false
    Part.Parent = Workspace

    local HumanoidRootPart = (LocalPlayer4.Character or LocalPlayer4.CharacterAdded:Wait()):WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local Sound2 = Instance.new("Sound")

    Sound2.Name = "BirdsSound"
    Sound2.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1237969272"
    Sound2.Looped = true
    Sound2.Volume = 0.05
    Sound2.Parent = Part

    local Sound3 = Instance.new("Sound")

    Sound3.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6654360741"
    Sound3.Volume = 0.05
    Sound3.Looped = false
    Sound3.Parent = Workspace
    RunService4.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if HumanoidRootPart and HumanoidRootPart.Parent then
            Part.Position = HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
        end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            local ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime

            if ClockTime >= 18 or ClockTime <= 6 then
                if Sound2.IsPlaying then
                    Sound2:Stop()
                end

                if Sound3.IsPlaying then
                    Sound3:Stop()
                end

                Sound3:Play()
            else
                if Sound3.IsPlaying then
                    Sound3:Stop()
                end

                if not Sound2.IsPlaying then
                    Sound2:Play()
                end
            end

            wait(20)
        end
    end)

    local Part2 = Instance.new("Part")

    Part2.Anchored = true
    Part2.CanCollide = false
    Part2.Transparency = 1
    Part2.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Part2.Position = Vector3.new(-27, 19, 15)
    Part2.Parent = Workspace

    local Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")

    Attachment.Position = Vector3.new(-27, 19, 15)
    Attachment.Parent = Part2

    local Sound4 = Instance.new("Sound")

    Sound4.Name = "FountainSound"
    Sound4.SoundId = "rbxassetid://4766793559"
    Sound4.Looped = true
    Sound4.Volume = 0.03
    Sound4.EmitterSize = 10
    Sound4.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
    Sound4.MaxDistance = 100
    Sound4.Parent = Attachment
    Sound4:Play()

    local Sound5 = Instance.new("Sound")

    Sound5.Name = "MyCustomSound"
    Sound5.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9048659736"
    Sound5.Volume = 0.01
    Sound5.Looped = true
    Sound5.PlayOnRemove = false
    Sound5.Parent = Workspace
    Sound5:Play()

    local u361 = false
    local t49 = {}
    local Folder = Instance.new("Folder", Workspace)

    Folder.Name = "ShootingStars"

    local Sound6 = Instance.new("Sound", Workspace)

    Sound6.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1843520836"
    Sound6.Volume = 0.3
    Sound6.Looped = true
    Sound6.Name = "SpaceAmbience"

    local function v365()
        local Part3 = Instance.new("Part")
        local v1315 = math.random(1, 3) * 0.5

        Part3.Size = Vector3.new(v1315, v1315, v1315)
        Part3.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-1000, 1000), math.random(300, 700), math.random(-1000, 1000))
        Part3.Anchored = true
        Part3.CanCollide = false
        Part3.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

        local t50 = {
				Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
				Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 180),
				Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 255)
			}

        Part3.Color = t50[math.random(1, #t50)]
        Part3.Name = "Star"
        Part3.Parent = Workspace

        local PointLight = Instance.new("PointLight", Part3)

        PointLight.Brightness = 2 + math.random() * 1.5
        PointLight.Range = 12
        spawn(function()
            while Part3.Parent and u361 do
                Part3.Transparency = 0.2 + math.sin(tick() * math.random(2, 5)) * 0.2
                RunService4.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end

            if Part3.Parent then
                Part3:Destroy()
            end
        end)
        table.insert(t49, Part3)
    end
    local function v366()
        if not u361 then
            return
        end
        local vector3 = Vector3.new(math.random(-1000, 1000), math.random(350, 600), math.random(-1000, 1000))
        local Unit = Vector3.new(math.random(-1, 1), math.random(-0.1, 0.1), math.random(-1, 1)).Unit
        local v1320 = math.random(350, 550)
        local v1321 = math.random() <= 0.3
        local v1322 = v1321 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 220)
        local v1323 = v1321 and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 50)) or ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 180))
        local Part4 = Instance.new("Part")
        Part4.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 3)
        Part4.Position = vector3
        Part4.Anchored = true
        Part4.CanCollide = false
        Part4.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        Part4.Color = v1322
        Part4.Name = "ShootingStar"
        Part4.Parent = Folder
        local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", Part4)
        local Attachment3 = Instance.new("Attachment", Part4)
        Attachment3.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -3)
        local Trail = Instance.new("Trail", Part4)
        Trail.Attachment0 = Attachment2
        Trail.Attachment1 = Attachment3
        Trail.Lifetime = 0.35
        Trail.Color = v1323
        Trail.LightEmission = 1
        Trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)
			})
        local PointLight = Instance.new("PointLight", Part4)
        PointLight.Brightness = not v1321 and 7 or 12
        PointLight.Range = 35
        PointLight.Color = v1322
        if v1321 then
            local Fire = Instance.new("Fire", Part4)

            Fire.Heat = 15
            Fire.Size = 3.5
            Fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 0)
            Fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 0)
        end
        local v1330 = math.random(1, 1.5)
        local n6 = 0
        local connection2
        connection2 = RunService4.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            if not u361 then
                connection2:Disconnect()

                if Part4.Parent then
                    Part4:Destroy()
                end

                return
            end

            n6 += dt

            if n6 >= v1330 then
                connection2:Disconnect()

                if Part4.Parent then
                    Part4:Destroy()
                end

                return
            end

            local v1818 = math.sin(n6 * 20) * 0.5
            local v1819 = Part4
            local s1 = "Position"
            local v1821 = (Unit + Vector3.new(0, v1818, 0)).Unit * v1320 * dt

            v1819[s1] = v1819[s1] + v1821
        end)
        Debris:AddItem(Part4, 4)
    end
    local function v367()
        local ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime
        local v1334 = ClockTime >= 18 or ClockTime < 6

        if v1334 and not u361 then
            u361 = true
            Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 30)
            Lighting.FogEnd = 5000
            Lighting.Brightness = 2

            for _, v in ipairs(t49) do
                if v and v.Parent then
                    v:Destroy()
                end
            end

            t49 = {}

            for _, child in ipairs(Folder:GetChildren()) do
                child:Destroy()
            end

            for _ = 1, 300 do
                v365()
            end

            Sound6:Play()

            return
        end

        if not v1334 and u361 then
            u361 = false
            for v1342, v1343 in ipairs(t49) do

                if v1343 and v1343.Parent then
                    v1343:Destroy()
                end
            end
            for _, child in ipairs(Folder:GetChildren()) do
                child:Destroy()
            end
            Sound6:Stop()
            Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192)
            Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
            Lighting.Brightness = 2
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            if u361 then
                for _ = 1, 12 do
                    v366()
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end
            else
                task.wait(1)
            end
        end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            v367()
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    local Folder2 = Instance.new("Folder", Workspace)

    Folder2.Name = "FakeRain"

    local Sound7 = Instance.new("Sound", SoundService)

    Sound7.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9111139882"

            CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(v432, Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)

            local t60 = {}

            t1.value66 = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                local vector3 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

                if t60[Enum.KeyCode.W] then
                    vector3 += CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
                end

                if t60[Enum.KeyCode.S] then
                    vector3 -= CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
                end

                if t60[Enum.KeyCode.A] then
                    vector3 -= CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
                end

                if t60[Enum.KeyCode.D] then
                    vector3 += CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
                end

                if t60[Enum.KeyCode.E] then
                    vector3 += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
                end

                if t60[Enum.KeyCode.Q] then
                    vector3 -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
                end

                CurrentCamera.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame + vector3 * 1
            end)
            game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                t60[input.KeyCode] = true
            end)
            game:GetService("UserInputService").InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                t60[input.KeyCode] = false
            end)

            return
        end
    else
        if t1.value66 then
            t1.value66:Disconnect()
            t1.value66 = nil
        end

        CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom

        local Character = LocalPlayer9.Character

        if Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Character.Humanoid
        end
    end
end

function t1.value98()
    if t1.value97() then
        return
    end

        return
    end

    if not v542 then
        return

    local function v544()
        local Vehicles = game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("Vehicles")

        if Vehicles then
            return Vehicles:FindFirstChild(t1.value83.Name .. "Car")
        end

        return nil
    end

    local u545 = v544()

    if not u545 then
        v542.CFrame = CFrame.new(1118.81, 75.998, -1138.61)
        task.wait(0.5)
        t1.value84:WaitForChild("RE"):WaitForChild("1Ca1r"):FireServer("PickingCar", "SchoolBus")
        task.wait(1)
        u545 = v544()
    end

    if u545 then
        local v546 = u545:FindFirstChild("Body") and u545.Body:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat")

        if v546 and (Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and not Character.Humanoid.Sit) then
            if not Character.Humanoid.Sit then
                local _ = u545.Parent
            end

            repeat
                v542.CFrame = v546.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 0)
                task.wait()
            until Character.Humanoid.Sit or not u545.Parent

            if Character.Humanoid.Sit or not u545.Parent then
                for _, child in pairs(u545.Body:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Seat") then
                        child.CanTouch = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    spawn(function()
        while true do
            if t1.value88 then
                local t1value88_2 = t1.value82:FindFirstChild(t1.value88)

                if t1value88_2 and (t1value88_2.Character and t1value88_2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
                    local Humanoid = t1value88_2.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                    if Humanoid and Humanoid.Sit then
                        if Character.Humanoid then
                            local v1429 = u545
                            local t71 = { CFrame.new(Vector3.new(9999, -450, 9999)) }

                            v1429:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(v2(t71))

                            v542.CFrame = CFrame3
                        end

                        return

                    local HumanoidRootPart = t1value88_2.Character.HumanoidRootPart

                    local _math = math

                    local v1436 = _math.sin(v1435) * 4
                    local v1437 = math.cos(v1435) * 20

function t1.value142()
    local Players7 = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService9 = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LocalPlayer21 = Players7.LocalPlayer
    local HumanoidRootPart = (LocalPlayer21.Character or LocalPlayer21.CharacterAdded:Wait()):WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    task.wait(2)
    local t104 = {}
    for v820, v821 in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

        if v821:IsA("BasePart") and v821.Name:lower():find("door") and (v821.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude <= 1000 then
            table.insert(t104, v821)
            v821.CanCollide = false
            v821.Anchored = false
            v821.Massless = true
        end
    end
    if #t104 == 0 then
        return
    end
    local n19 = 0
    RunService9.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not LocalPlayer21.Character or (not HumanoidRootPart or not HumanoidRootPart.Parent) then
            t1.value141()

            return
        end

        n19 += dt * t1.value140

        for k, v in pairs(t104) do
            local v1556 = k

            if v and v.Parent then
                local v1557 = n19 + (v1556 - 1) * (6.283185307179586 / #t104)
                local vector3 = Vector3.new(math.cos(v1557) * 10, math.sin(n19 * 2 + v1556) * 2 + 5, math.sin(v1557) * 10)

                v.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(vector3) * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(n19 + v1556) * 0.5, v1557 + 1.5707963267948966, math.cos(n19 + v1556) * 0.5)
                v.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                v.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end
        end
    end)
end

function t1.value146()
    local Players8 = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService10 = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LocalPlayer22 = Players8.LocalPlayer
    local HumanoidRootPart = (LocalPlayer22.Character or LocalPlayer22.CharacterAdded:Wait()):WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    task.wait(2)
    local t105 = {}
    for _, descendant in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local v832 = descendant:IsA("Tool")

        if not v832 then
            v832 = descendant:IsA("Model")

            if v832 then
                v832 = descendant.Name:lower():find("tool")

                if not v832 then
                    v832 = descendant.Name:lower():find("weapon") or (descendant.Name:lower():find("sword") or descendant.Name:lower():find("gun"))
                end
            end
        end

        if v832 then
            table.insert(t105, descendant)
        else
            local v833 = descendant:IsA("BasePart")

            if v833 then
                v833 = descendant.Name:lower():find("tool")

                if not v833 then
                    v833 = descendant.Name:lower():find("weapon")

                    if not v833 then
                        v833 = descendant.Name:lower():find("sword") or (descendant.Name:lower():find("gun") or descendant.Name:lower():find("item"))
                    end
                end
            end

            if v833 then
                table.insert(t105, descendant)
            end
        end
    end
    local GetPlayers = Players8.GetPlayers
    for v837, v838 in pairs(GetPlayers(Players8)) do

        if v838 ~= LocalPlayer22 and v838.Character then

            for v841, v842 in pairs(v838.Character:GetDescendants()) do

                if v842:IsA("Tool") then
                    table.insert(t105, v842)
                end
            end
            if v838:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then
                for _, descendant in pairs(v838.Backpack:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant:IsA("Tool") then
                        table.insert(t105, descendant)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, v in pairs(t105) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") then
            v.CanCollide = false
            v.Anchored = false
            v.Massless = true
        elseif v:IsA("Model") and v.PrimaryPart then
            v.PrimaryPart.CanCollide = false
            v.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false

            local PrimaryPart = v.PrimaryPart
            local GetDescendants = v.GetDescendants

            PrimaryPart.Massless = true

            for _, v4 in pairs(GetDescendants(v)) do
                if v4:IsA("BasePart") then
                    v4.CanCollide = false
                    v4.Massless = true
                end
            end
        elseif v:IsA("Tool") and v:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
            v.Handle.CanCollide = false
            v.Handle.Anchored = false

            local Handle = v.Handle
            local GetDescendants = v.GetDescendants

            Handle.Massless = true

            for _, v7 in pairs(GetDescendants(v)) do
                if v7:IsA("BasePart") then
                    v7.CanCollide = false
                    v7.Massless = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #t105 == 0 then
        return
    end
    local n20 = 0
    local n21 = 0
    RunService10.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not LocalPlayer22.Character or (not HumanoidRootPart or not HumanoidRootPart.Parent) then
            t1.value145()

            return
        end

        n20 += dt * t1.value144
        n21 += dt

        for k, v in pairs(t105) do
            local v1562 = not v
            local v1563 = k

            if not v1562 then
                v1562 = not v.Parent
            end

            if not v1562 then
                local v1564 = (v1563 * 2 + math.sin(n21 + v1563) * 3) % 50
                local v1565 = n20
                local v1566 = v1563 * 0.5
                local _math = math
                local v1568 = 8 + v1564 * 0.3
                local v1569 = v1565 + v1566 % (_math.pi * 2)
                local vector3 = Vector3.new(math.cos(v1569) * v1568, v1564, math.sin(v1569) * v1568)
                local cFrame20 = CFrame.Angles(n21 * 2 + v1563, v1569 + 1.5707963267948966, n21 + v1563)

                if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                    v.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(vector3) * cFrame20
                    v.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    v.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                elseif v:IsA("Model") and v.PrimaryPart then
                    v:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(vector3) * cFrame20)
                    v.PrimaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    v.PrimaryPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                elseif v:IsA("Tool") and v:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
                    v.Handle.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(vector3) * cFrame20
                    v.Handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    v.Handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

        _G.a = nil
    end
    local _ = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    repeat
        task.wait()
    until game.Players.LocalPlayer
    a = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local u1012
    local Humanoid
    local HumanoidRootPart
    local u1015 = false
    local t130 = {}
    local function v1017()
        u1012 = a.Character or a.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        Humanoid = u1012:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        HumanoidRootPart = u1012:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        t130 = {}

        for _, descendant in pairs(u1012:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Transparency == 0 then
                t130[#t130 + 1] = descendant
            end
        end
    end
    local function v1018()
        local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        local TextButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
        TextButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 50)
        TextButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 0.1, 0)

        ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        local u1705 = false
        local inputPosition
        local TextButtonPosition
        TextButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                u1705 = true
                inputPosition = input.Position
                TextButtonPosition = TextButton.Position
            end
        end)
        TextButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and u1705 then
                local v1869 = input.Position - inputPosition

                TextButton.Position = UDim2.new(TextButtonPosition.X.Scale, TextButtonPosition.X.Offset + v1869.X, TextButtonPosition.Y.Scale, TextButtonPosition.Y.Offset + v1869.Y)
            end
        end)
        TextButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            end
        end)
        TextButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            u1015 = not u1015

            for _, v in pairs(t130) do
                v.Transparency = not u1015 and 0 or 0.5
            end
        end)
    end
    v1017()
    v1018()
    local t132 = {
			[1] = a:GetMouse().KeyDown:Connect(function(p147)
        if p147 == "g" then
            u1015 = not u1015

            for _, v in pairs(t130) do
                v.Transparency = not u1015 and 0 or 0.5
            end
        end
    end),
			[2] = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if u1015 then

function t1.value160(p148)
    if not t1.value158 or t1.value156 == "Rainbow" then
        return
    end

    for i = 1, #p148 - 1 do
        local v1202 = not t1.value158
        local v1203 = i

        if not v1202 then
            v1202 = t1.value156 == "Rainbow"
        end

        if v1202 then
            return
        end

        local v1204 = p148[v1203]
        local v1205 = p148[v1203 + 1]

        for j = 0, 1, 0.05 do
            if not t1.value158 or t1.value156 == "Rainbow" then
                return
            end

            local v1207 = v1204:Lerp(v1205, j)

            t1.value159:FireServer(unpack({
				"PickingRPNameColor",
				v1207
			}))

            local value159 = t1.value159
            local t162 = { unpack({
				"PickingRPBioColor",
				v1207
			}) }

            value159:FireServer(v2(t162))
            task.wait(t1.value157)
        end
    end

    local v1210 = p148[#p148]
    local v1211 = p148[1]

    for i = 0, 1, 0.05 do
        if not t1.value158 or t1.value156 == "Rainbow" then
            return
        end

        local v1213 = v1210:Lerp(v1211, i)

        t1.value159:FireServer(unpack({
			"PickingRPNameColor",
			v1213
		}))
        t1.value159:FireServer(unpack({
			"PickingRPBioColor",
			v1213
		}))
        task.wait(t1.value157)
    end
end
